# How right is it?

*Generated by `content/validation/archetypes/report.py` from `tee-validate --simulator` on each archetype (`content/validation/archetypes/`). Do not edit by hand: run it again.*

Each archetype build is held to what an engine and car of its kind measure as: published figures, textbook ranges and rules of thumb, each target with its source in its file. Only the invariants (it starts, stays within full scale, holds its limiter, pulls away, stops at the key) must pass; every other miss is reported, not failed. **The misses are the simulator's to-do list.**

Measured on the predicted dyno curve (steady full-throttle points, warm) and on the scenarios of `content/validation/scenarios/` (`p-*`), in the build's own air (15 C, 101.3 kPa).

| V10 5.2 L | 1179 rpm | 850 rpm to 1150 rpm |
| V12 6.5 L | 1299 rpm | 850 rpm to 1150 rpm |

### Charge temperature under boost (5)

*Source: an air-to-air intercooler of 0.6 to 0.8 effectiveness leaves the charge some 10 to 50 K over the outside air at full boost (makers' and tuners' intake-air-temperature logs; judgement): reported so the over-delivery at a given boost can be judged (the lead's ask).*

| Archetype | Measured | Should be |
|---|---|---|
| Flat-plane 3.9 L V8, twin turbo | 351 K | 293 K to 340 K |
| 6.7 L straight-six turbo diesel pickup | 366 K | 293 K to 340 K |
| Rotary twin | 361 K | 293 K to 340 K |
| Highway tractor 15 L | 403 K | 293 K to 340 K |
| Twin-turbo 4.0 L hot-vee V8 | 346 K | 293 K to 340 K |

### Volumetric efficiency low down (4)

*Source: VE's shape: below the torque peak it falls away, the more so the hotter the cam (Heywood, Internal Combustion Engine Fundamentals, ch. 6); measured at 2000 rpm.*

| Archetype | Measured | Should be |
|---|---|---|
| Flat-plane 4.5 L V8 | 0.69 | 0.70 to 0.95 |
| 3.2 L straight six, high-revving | 0.66 | 0.70 to 0.95 |
| V10 5.2 L | 0.69 | 0.70 to 0.95 |
| 3.5 L V6 | 0.98 | 0.70 to 0.95 |

### Lambda at full load under boost (3)

*Source: a turbo diesel at full load runs lambda 1.2 to 2 (smoke-limited; Heywood, Internal Combustion Engine Fundamentals, ch. 10).*

| Archetype | Measured | Should be |
|---|---|---|
| Diesel 2.0 L common rail | 1 | 1.2 to 2 |
| 6.7 L straight-six turbo diesel pickup | 1 | 1.2 to 2 |
| Highway tractor 15 L | 1 | 1.2 to 2 |

### Volumetric efficiency at its torque peak (2)

*Source: a naturally aspirated four-stroke's VE at full load near its torque peak is 0.85 to 1.0 (Heywood, Internal Combustion Engine Fundamentals, ch. 6, fig. 6-9 and the text); measured at 6000 rpm.*

| Archetype | Measured | Should be |
|---|---|---|
| Flat-plane 4.5 L V8 | 0.77 | 0.82 to 1.02 |
| Two-stage-cam 2.0 L | 0.79 | 0.82 to 1.02 |
